workshops.title: Jaipur Blue Pottery Glaze & Wheel Masterclass
workshops.organizerName: Rajasthan Small Industries Corporation & Kripal Kumbh
workshops.description: 5-day intensive masterclass on quartz powder preparation, Egyptian copper oxide blue glazing, and traditional charcoal kiln firing.

workshops.title: Kutch Ajrakh 16-Step Natural Resist Dyeing Camp
workshops.description: Hands-on 16-step natural dyeing workshop using fermented iron rust, madder root, harda pre-treatment, and hand-carved teakwood blocks.

workshops.title: Banaras Katan Silk Jacquard Weaving Workshop
workshops.organizerName: Weavers Service Centre & Ministry of Textiles
workshops.description: Learn complex Naqsha drawing, Jacquard card punching, and pure gold zari border weaving from 4th-generation master weavers.

workshops.title: Madhubani Mithila Folk Painting Intensive Camp
workshops.description: Master Bharni, Kachni, and Godna traditional styles using bamboo nib pens and organic pigment extraction from marigold, soot, and turmeric.

workshops.title: Assam Golden Bamboo & Cane Weaving Studio
workshops.description: Seasoning, fine strip splitting, cross-hatch interlocking, and moisture-resistant natural smoking for high-value export baskets and lifestyle furniture.

workshops.title: Channapatna Eco-Lacquer Toy Turning Masterclass
workshops.description: Safe, non-toxic woodturning on traditional lathes using soft Wrightia tinctoria (Aale Mara) wood and natural vegetable lacquer resin sticks.

workshops.title: Jamnagar Natural Indigo Bandhani Tying Masterclass
workshops.organizerName: Crafts Council of India & Kutch Mahila Mandal
workshops.description: Learn 5,000-knot micro-pinpoint tying, Shikari and Ekdali patterns, and cold-vat organic indigo fermentation on pure mulberry silk fabrics.

workshops.title: Bastar Lost-Wax Dokra Bell Metal Casting Guild
workshops.description: 4,000-year-old Harappan cire perdue method: pure beeswax thread detailing, riverbed clay cores, and open charcoal pit bronze casting.

workshops.title: Srinagar Pashmina Charkha Spinning & Sozni Embroidery
workshops.description: Manual combing of Grade-A Changthangi mountain goat fleece, takli spindle spinning, and micro-single thread needlework (Sozni).

workshops.title: Thanjavur 22K Gold Foil Sacred Painting Camp
workshops.description: Teakwood plank preparation with unbleached muslin, chalk paste gesso relief work, Jaipur semi-precious gem embedding, and 22-karat gold leaf gilding.

workshops.title: Palghar Warli Earth Pigment Tribal Canvas Studio
workshops.description: Traditional geru earth and cow-dung wash backgrounds, white rice paste pigment preparation, and dynamic geometric circle-of-life storytelling.

workshops.title: Bidar Silver Wire Inlay & Soil Oxidization Camp
workshops.trainer: Shah Rasheed Ahmed Quadri (Padma Shri Recipient)
workshops.description: Zinc-copper alloy casting, chisel engraving of Persian arabesques, pure 99.9% silver wire inlaying, and black patination using historic Bidar Fort soil.

workshops.title: Raghurajpur Palm Leaf Etching & Talapatra Scroll Camp
workshops.description: Curing dried palmyra palm leaves, iron stylus fine incising, lamp-black carbon rubbing, and accordion-fold natural twine binding.

workshops.title: Lucknow Shadow-Stitch Chikankari Needlework Guild
workshops.organizerName: SEWA Lucknow & All India Handicrafts Board
workshops.description: Mastering the 32 authentic stitches: Bakhiya (shadow stitch), Phanda, Murri, Tepchi, and Jaali open-work on translucent fine mulmul cotton.

workshops.title: Sanganeri Wooden Block Carving & Pigment Printing
workshops.organizerName: Calico Printers Guild & Jaipur Crafts Cluster
workshops.description: Shisham and teak wood carving of botanical bootis, pin-point registration alignment, and non-bleeding discharge pigment printing on fine cotton.

workshops.title: Bankura Terracotta Kiln Firing & Panchmura Horse Workshop
workshops.organizerName: West Bengal Khadi & Village Industries Board
workshops.description: Wheel throwing of hollow body segments, hand-modeled erect ears and decorative neck bridles, and wood-fired open downdraft brick kilns.

workshops.title: Pochampally Telia Rumal Double Ikat Weaving Camp
workshops.organizerName: Telangana State Handloom Weavers Co-op Society
workshops.description: Mathematical warp and weft alignment, castor oil yarn pre-treatment, natural alizarin red dye baths, and precision grid loom setting.

workshops.title: Kullu Looms Angora & Sheep Wool Geometric Shawl Weaving
workshops.organizerName: Bharmour Weavers Society & HP State Handloom Corp
workshops.location: Bhutico Complex, Shamshi, Kullu, Himachal Pradesh
workshops.description: Frame loom setting, interlocking slit tapestry weave, and vibrant Tibetan-influenced geometric borders on local indigenous sheep wool.

workshops.title: Cuttack Tarakasi 99.9% Silver Wire Filigree Studio
workshops.description: Drawing pure silver down to hair-thin wires, spiral twisting, micro-soldering with borax paste, and crafting exquisite gossamer peacocks and konark wheels.

workshops.title: Dindori Gond Narrative Folk Art & Forest Mythology Camp
workshops.organizerName: Tribal Welfare Dept & Indira Gandhi Manav Sangrahalaya
workshops.description: Intricate signature fill patterns (lines, dots, fish scales, waves) representing Pardhan Gond animist mythology, sacred Mahua trees, and forest spirits.

schemes.title: PM Vishwakarma Artisan Support Scheme
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
schemes.eligibility: Traditional artisans & craftspeople practicing 18 heritage trades (including potters, weavers, toy makers, blacksmiths).
schemes.benefits: Free 5-7 days basic training + ₹500/day stipend; ₹15,000 e-voucher for modern ergonomic tools; Phase-1 ₹1 Lakh and Phase-2 ₹2 Lakh credit; PM Vishwakarma digital ID & badge.

schemes.title: One District One Product (ODOP) Initiative
schemes.subsidy: Up to ₹ 50,00,000 Cluster Common Facility Centre Support
schemes.eligibility: Registered artisan producer groups, SHGs, and cooperatives representing the designated unique craft of their district.
schemes.benefits: Dedicated retail stalls at airports, rail stations, and trade missions; international exhibition subsidies; professional export packaging design; official ODOP trademark tagging.

schemes.title: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) Saras Collection
schemes.subsidy: 100% Fee Waiver for Artisans, SHGs & Weavers
schemes.eligibility: Verified artisans, GI certificate holders, and women SHG collectives supplying authentic Indian handicrafts.
schemes.benefits: Direct procurement access to 70,000+ government offices, ministries, public sector undertakings, and defense establishments; guaranteed 10-day invoice clearance; zero listing fees.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (Tarun & Kishor)
schemes.ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
schemes.subsidy: Loans up to ₹ 10,00,000 without Third-Party Collateral
schemes.eligibility: Self-employed individual master craftsmen, micro artisan enterprises, and rural handloom units requiring raw material capital.
schemes.benefits: Zero processing fee for loans under ₹50,000; flexible MUDRA RuPay debit card for on-demand raw material purchasing; subsidized interest rates.

schemes.title: MSME Udyam Registration & Credit Linked Subsidy (CLCSS)
schemes.subsidy: 15% Capital Subsidy for Upgraded Eco-Tools & Kilns
schemes.eligibility: Micro artisan units with Udyam registration updating traditional production infrastructure (e.g. electric potter wheels, smokeless kilns).
schemes.benefits: Official MSME recognition; priority sector lending; exemption on patent & GI registry filing fees; 25% public procurement quota preference.

schemes.title: Export Promotion Scheme for Handicrafts (MAI / MDA)
schemes.ministry: Export Promotion Council for Handicrafts (EPCH) & Ministry of Textiles
schemes.subsidy: Up to ₹ 2,50,000 Travel & Stall Subsidy for International Expos
schemes.eligibility: Artisan entrepreneurs, exporter-cooperatives, and GI tag producers with valid IEC (Import Export Code).
schemes.benefits: Reimbursement for stall rental at trade fairs in Frankfurt, Tokyo, Milan, and New York; international buyer matching; export compliance certification grants.

schemes.title: National Handloom Development Programme (NHDP)
schemes.subsidy: 100% Subsidy on Pneumatic Looms & 15% Yarn Price Subsidy
schemes.eligibility: Active traditional weavers holding Weaver Pehchan Card or organized under weaver primary cooperatives.
schemes.benefits: Yarn supply at subsidized mill gate prices; lighting units for loom pits; solar inverter support for weaving clusters; health and life insurance coverage.

schemes.title: SFURTI Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries
schemes.subsidy: Up to ₹ 2.5 Crore for Regular Clusters and ₹ 5 Crore for Major Clusters
schemes.eligibility: Artisan clusters comprising minimum 500 traditional artisans formed into a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) with NGO partners.
schemes.benefits: Establishment of Common Facility Centres (CFC) with state-of-the-art testing labs, raw material banks, computer-aided design studios, and packaging lines.

schemes.title: Ambedkar Hastshilp Vikas Yojana (AHVY)
schemes.eligibility: Artisan Self Help Groups (SHGs) and craft clusters in rural and semi-urban artisan concentrations.
schemes.benefits: Empanelment with top NID/NIFT fashion designers; baseline cluster socio-economic survey; community craft sheds construction support.

schemes.title: National GI Artisan Registration & Brand Tagging Grant
schemes.ministry: Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM)
schemes.subsidy: 100% Waiver of Authorized User Application Fees
schemes.eligibility: Genuine practitioners in demarcated Geographical Indication territories of registered Indian craft tags.
schemes.benefits: Issuance of official Hologram GI Authorized User Certificate; legal protection against synthetic and factory imitations; direct integration with VIRASAT GI verification.
